items.title: Meta Sued Over Training Data for Its AI and Face-Recognition Systems
items.summary: The proposed class action alleges Meta illegally harvested people’s Facebook and Instagram photos to train its AI image-generation models and to build its unreleased “NameTag” face recognition feature.
items.author: Dhruv Mehrotra

items.title: One of AI’s Fiercest Critics Says All the Doom Talk Is ‘Meant to Distract Us’
items.summary: Timnit Gebru argues that AI companies are stoking fears of extinction to avoid discussing actual harms, like autonomous weapons.
items.author: Lauren Goode

items.title: Why So Many AI Researchers Think the Machines Could Kill Everyone
items.summary: A combination of rapid advances, recursive self-improvement, and agentic swarms are genuinely “spooking people” inside big labs.
items.author: Will Knight
